name: Golden Idol of Good Fortunes

summary: Cast Augury once per dawn; the idol speaks its omen.
text: Cast Augury once per dawn; the idol speaks its omen. +1 AC while attuned. Reference-only: while held, Magic action converts a touched nonmagical trade bar or gemstone into coins of equal value. Reference-only: while holding the idol, cast Globe of Invulnerability once per dawn.
